fusions.name: Wound in Thread
fusions.desc: Your tongue winds around one enemy up to 6 tiles away, dealing 12 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at its full reach, and stunning it for 1.2 seconds. It then moves 30% slower for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Running Stitch
fusions.desc: Your tongue passes through the first enemy in its path up to 7 tiles away for 26 damage, then through 3 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 70% of the original damage. It ignores armour.

fusions.name: Damp Dressing
fusions.desc: Wraps the ally who needs it most in a damp dressing, restoring 3 health a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Quilted Give
fusions.desc: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, you gain a ward worth 15% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
